rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted points is within the threshold.
Verifies that active Quarterly and Annual Coal StatVars have observations within 1 to 2 years of the current year and rank price/distribution series are within 3 years.

params.condition: CAST(SUBSTR(MaxDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Quarterly_') THEN 1 WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Annual_') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

rules.description: Verifies the generated output CSV data matches established critical golden records
